# table-without-primary-key

- Dialects: mysql, postgres, sqlite
- Default: on

## Why

Without a primary key rows cannot be addressed individually, replication and ORMs lose their handle on a row, and duplicates cannot be prevented.

## Fix

Declare a primary key on the model that maps to the table and regenerate the schema.

## Exception

Append-only tables that are never updated or referenced, such as a raw event log, when the reason is written down.

The same text is printed by `schemalens explain table-without-primary-key`. An exclusion needs a written reason. Back to the [rule index](README.md).
